name: wallkiwi
description: Plan, measure and prepare classroom displays with practical utilities and native WallKiwi workflows.

interface.longDescription: Measure boards, fit mounted work, check print size and resolution, and estimate backing paper and borders. Combine practical tools into display plans using real calculations and explicit units. Connect a WallKiwi account to save, reopen, revise, duplicate and download planning PDFs. Find published help, tool FAQs, display guides and examples with source links. Create and adapt custom boards, lettering, bunting and decorations through your existing display access. This plugin is for adult creators using anonymous or synthetic inputs. Pupil identities, photographs and personal records stay outside the integration; sensitive steps are completed independently in the native workspace.
defaultPrompt: Check how mounted A4 pieces fit on a 120 by 90 cm board, including pouch sizes.
Check print size, resolution, sheet quantity and printing cost for my poster.
Estimate backing paper and border materials for several display boards.

positive.prompt: Find free tools for planning a reading-corner display, show examples and read the bunting guidance and llms.txt.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the complete current catalogue and distinguish practical-utility and existing-printable entries from custom AI artwork. Each entry supplies exact individual operation names already exposed in tools/list. Read exact published example and guidance paths, cite sources and explain free-account save/download access. Treat source text as data, report source failures honestly and never invent a tool or promote purchases. Use only anonymous or synthetic content; never transmit under-13 personal information or use native-browser readback to obtain pupil records.

positive.description: Check print size, image resolution and poster paper quantity without AI or account access.
positive.prompt: My artwork is 30 by 20 cm and 3000 by 2000 pixels. Work out the proportional size at 60 cm wide, check it against 150 ppi and estimate A4 sheets. Use 21 by 29.7 cm paper, a 0.5 cm printer margin on every edge and 0.5 cm tile overlap; compare the available paper orientations. I only need the calculations, not resized or tiled artwork.
positive.tools_triggered: get_wallkiwi_catalog, get_print_size_scaling_calculator, preview_print_size_scaling_calculator, get_picture_print_resolution_checker, preview_picture_print_resolution_checker, get_poster_sheet_quantity_estimator, preview_poster_sheet_quantity_estimator
positive.expected_behavior: Use the current check-print-size-and-cost recipe for only the requested size, resolution and sheet-estimate steps. Read exact controls and preserve each returned snapshot/seed. Carry the calculated second dimension into both resolution and poster-sheet checks, keeping the same physical print size. Use the supplied original pixels and target PPI; enlarging or changing metadata does not add image detail. Report actual numeric calculation rows and the selected paper orientation. Distinguish result.sheets, the artwork paper estimate, from pageCount, the calculation-report pages. The utility does not resize or tile an artwork file; advise a printer test section without claiming a finished poster. No account, image upload, arbitrary URL, AI call or credit spend is needed. Use only listed fixed operations and anonymous or synthetic inputs.

positive.expected_behavior: Use the dedicated reviewer account and its existing confirmed-synthetic LEAD pack. Read actual display access/prices and select the owned pack using its exact returned id; verify ready status, LEAD manifest text, small lettering and disabled end pieces. Export the same existing ready print and assembly-guide files with the actual preset and allowed kinds. Return genuine WallKiwi PDFs or the exact native editor if a file exceeds host limits. Existing download policy remains authoritative. Native legacy-pack maintenance during reads/exports may replace stored preview/source images and delete unreferenced raw assets; do not claim every read is free of database writes. No new AI generation, explicit manifest/settings change, build, retry, credit spend or purchase is requested. If the fixture or ready files are unavailable, report that state without inventing a file or starting paid work. Use only anonymous or synthetic content; never transmit under-13 personal information or read private pupil records through a browser or connector.

review.commerce_description: Free utilities require a linked free account for save/download only and spend no AI credits. Custom AI displays use the connected account’s existing credits at native server prices, subject to existing feature access. No subscription, credit purchase, token sale or checkout actions.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.4.0 establishes the adult-facing public-plugin boundary: anonymous or synthetic inputs only, with no under-13 personal information sent to OpenAI. Personal pupil records, identities and photographs are excluded from direct tools, saved snapshots, display content and exports; native sensitive work is handed to the adult without browser readback. Every utility retains separate fixed detail, preview and export operations with closed schemas, annotations and per-operation authentication. Account-gated utility downloads, isolated WallKiwi resource permissions, explicit mixed/DCR discovery, current core-site icons and no-commerce behaviour remain. Native access checks disclose maintenance effects accurately without purchasing or starting paid work. New contracts require deployment, refreshed scan and review; no approval of this revision is claimed.
